SolveSpace NG is a personal fork of SolveSpace: a keyboard-first interface, Open CASCADE
features (fillets, chamfers, shells, drafts, holes and threads, lofts, sweeps, STEP) and
multi-part assemblies with joints and fits. It may change or break at any time; known problems
are the repository's issues.

**Downloads**

- **Linux** (`solvespace-ng-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`): unpack anywhere and run
  `bin/solvespace-ng`. Built on Ubuntu 22.04; needs glibc 2.35 or later, OpenGL, libpng, FreeType and
  the OpenMP runtime (libgomp).
- **Windows** (`solvespace-ng-windows-x64.zip`): unpack and run `solvespace-ng.exe`. Keep the
  DLLs beside it.
- **macOS** (`solvespace-ng-macos-arm64.zip`, Apple silicon): unpack and move
  *SolveSpace NG* to Applications. It is signed ad hoc, not notarized: the first time, open it
  with right-click ▸ Open (or allow it in System Settings ▸ Privacy & Security). Built without
  OpenMP.

**In the browser:** https://chalkwalk.github.io/solvespace-ng/
